name: Dzung X Vo
reason: Re-checked 12 Nov 2026 (web search): a paediatrician in adolescent medicine at BC Children's Hospital and UBC who practises in Thich Nhat Hanh's Plum Village tradition (dharma name True Garden of Diligence) and wrote The Mindful Teen. His teaching is delivered as hospital and clinical programmes (MARS-A, an eight-week mindfulness programme for teens with depressive symptoms, via the Kelty Mental Health centre), and no website of his own, public classes or retreats he leads, or published email or contact form turned up. Nothing listable and no contact route; owner could revisit if he has a personal site.
